description: Sink — write a pandas DataFrame to an HTTP/REST endpoint via POST / PUT, per-record or batched.

outputs.description: Write confirmation with metadata (or the enriched DataFrame when write_response_to_record=true)

upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset producing the DataFrame to write
upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key

url.description: Target URL. In per_record mode, may template row values via {column_name}.
url.label: URL

batch_mode.label: Batch Mode
batch_mode.description: 'per_record' — one request per row, body = that row as a JSON object. 'batch_array' — chunks of `batch_size` rows, body = a JSON array of row objects. 'ndjson' — chunks of `batch_size` rows, body = newline-delimited JSON (Content-Type: application/x-ndjson).

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Rows per request for `batch_array` / `ndjson` modes. Ignored for `per_record`.

oauth2_client_id_env_var.label: Oauth2 Client Id Env Var
oauth2_client_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the OAuth2 client ID. Required for auth_type='oauth2_client_credentials'.

oauth2_client_secret_env_var.label: Oauth2 Client Secret Env Var
oauth2_client_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the OAuth2 client secret. Required for auth_type='oauth2_client_credentials'.

headers.label: Headers
headers.description: Extra static HTTP headers sent with every request.

skip_columns.label: Skip Columns
skip_columns.description: Columns to drop before serializing the row body (e.g. internal pandas columns).

write_response_to_record.label: Write Response To Record
write_response_to_record.description: When true, append `http_response_status` / `http_response_body` / `http_response_json` columns to each row and materialize the enriched DataFrame as this asset's output, instead of a plain sink with no output value. In batch modes (`batch_array`/`ndjson`), every row in a chunk gets that chunk's single response recorded (requests aren't per-row, so the response can't be attributed more granularly than its batch).

response_json_path.label: Response Json Path
response_json_path.description: Only used with write_response_to_record. Dotted path into the parsed JSON response to extract into `http_response_value` (e.g. 'data.id' for {'data': {'id': 123}}). Leave unset to only get the raw body/status/full JSON.

max_retries.label: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Retries per request before giving up on it.

retry_backoff_seconds.label: Retry Backoff Seconds
retry_backoff_seconds.description: Base delay for exponential backoff between retries (delay = base * 2**attempt).

retry_on_status_codes.label: Retry On Status Codes
retry_on_status_codes.description: Response status codes that trigger a retry (in addition to connection/timeout errors, which always retry).

fail_after_n_failures.label: Fail After N Failures
fail_after_n_failures.description: Abort the whole materialization after this many failed requests (sampled in `failures_sample` metadata).

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column
partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter upstream rows to the current date partition (time partitions).

partition_static_column.label: Static Partition Column
partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter upstream rows to the current static/dynamic partition key.

partition_static_dim.label: Partition Static Dim
partition_static_dim.description: Name of the static axis in a multi-partition, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'.

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one run. 'multi_run' launches one run per partition (optionally capped via backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run). Leave unset for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when partition_type is not set.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Policy Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For backfill_policy='multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave unset for Dagster's default (1 partition per run).

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
